title: CTR last segment can be shorter than block length
summary: CTR encrypts counter blocks to produce a keystream and XORs it with the data. A partial final block uses only the corresponding keystream bits.
applies: Byte representation and parameter explanation of cryptography questions
detail: When calculating only the ciphertext payload of the pattern itself, the byte length is the same as the original text.
boundary: The outer layer may additionally store nonces, counters, or tags; the total length of the stored files does not need to equal the payload length.
relevance: Distinguish between 16-byte aligned block formats and naturally reserved length data segments.
